name: WordPress
description: Let agents draft posts on your WordPress site for an editor to review: find and read posts, create drafts or posts waiting for review and, if you allow it, edit posts. Agents never publish.
identity: An application password of a WordPress user. Agents act as that user, so make one with the Author or Contributor role.

setup.title: Create a user for agents
setup.body: Make a WordPress user for agents with the Contributor role (writes posts for review) or Author. Agents can only ever save drafts or posts pending review, whatever the role.
click: In WordPress admin, go to Users, then Add New User, and create a user named Agents with the Contributor role.

setup.title: Create an application password
setup.body: Application passwords work over https only and need WordPress 5.6 or later. WordPress shows the password once.
click: In WordPress admin, go to Users, then edit the Agents user.
Under Application Passwords, enter the name Agents and select Add New Application Password.

fields.label: Site address
fields.help: Your site's host name, without https:// or a path.

capabilities.label: Read posts
capabilities.description: Find posts by text or status, read one post, and list categories and tags.

capabilities.label: Write drafts
capabilities.description: Create posts as drafts or pending review. Nothing is published.

capabilities.label: Edit posts
capabilities.description: Change a post's title, content, excerpt, categories or tags, or set it back to draft or pending review.
capabilities.note: Edits to a published post show on the site at once, and setting one to draft takes it down. A Contributor can edit only their own unpublished posts, so give agents that role if they should never touch live posts.

revoke: In WordPress admin, edit the Agents user and revoke the application password under Application Passwords. Agents lose access to the site at once.

tools.name: wordpress_list_posts
tools.description: Find posts, newest first, by text or status.

page.description: The page, from the previous answer

tools.name: wordpress_get_post
tools.description: Read one post, with its content.

tools.name: wordpress_create_draft
tools.description: Create a post as a draft, or pending review for an editor.

content.description: The content, as HTML or block markup

tools.name: wordpress_update_post
tools.description: Edit a post. Only the fields you send change. Edits to a published post show on the site at once.

content.description: The content, as HTML or block markup

status.description: Set it to draft or pending review (leave out to keep its status)
